summary.text: Jade Flow Pearl is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move built around rank seven Fixed Immortal Travel. It is a compound move of space path and refinement path that can teleport him after he reaches rank eight.

claims.text: After annexing Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan arrives above Contact Heart River bank in Southern Border by jade green light and bubbles from Immortal killer move Jade Flow Pearl, and he savors the move he just used to teleport. The move uses rank seven Fixed Immortal Travel as the core, almost all of his then space path Immortal Gu, a few refinement path Immortal Gu, and many supplementary mortal Gu. After he annexes Lang Ya blessed land and becomes rank eight, his dao marks rise so far that rank seven Fixed Immortal Travel alone cannot teleport him; only a stronger killer move lets him barely move.

In his previous life he also built a Fixed Immortal Travel core movement killer move at rank eight, but that earlier move was pure space path. Jade Flow Pearl is a compound killer move of space path and refinement path. He lacks the specific space path rank seven Immortal Gu he once extorted from Southern Border’s righteous path, so most of his current space path Immortal Gu come from Lang Ya’s inventory at rank six and fit poorly. Refinement path Immortal Gu let him modify the move so refinement path dao marks stop burdening the teleport, which is the advantage of a compound killer move. Compound moves are harder to deduce; he reaches this one quickly through quasi-supreme refinement path attainment and the light of wisdom.

He later lists modifying jade flow pearl among urgent tasks. The same Fixed Immortal Travel core construction is already exposed from many uses, and he expects others to seek counters, so he wants a new version ready. In movement he is heavily relying on Omni-directional Travel and this Fixed Immortal Travel killer move as an escape if something goes wrong.
Fang Yuan casts Immortal killer move Jade Flow Pearl again after the rewrite succeeds: activation is faster, and the aura leaked at the destination is smaller and less eye-catching than before.

Because he now has jade flow pearl, an opponent cannot use fixed space Immortal Gu alone to counter him the way a previous-life Fixed Immortal Travel cast could be stopped; that opponent needs an immortal killer move instead.
Fang Yuan again activates Immortal killer move Jade Flow Pearl and arrives at the Five Regional Mountain Range, noting that Fixed Immortal Travel makes traveling convenient.
After Fang Yuan annexes Qi Sea grotto-heaven, jade flow pearl stops being effective, and he has to use Omni-directional Travel instead to move around.
Among Fang Yuan’s compound killer moves, jade flow pearl is formed from refinement path and space path.
